title: Zephyrine and the Vector
author: Ivo Thackeray
blurb: Paloma Quintana, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
